name: Dunna
title: Keeper of the Wanderer's Rest
examine: Flour to the elbows, copper hair escaping its knot, and a laugh you can hear from the Round.
lines: Sit anywhere that isn't the hearthstone. Stew's on.
My mother kept this bar before me. She waters mules up at Silverfall now, and says the mountain air suits her hips.
Every rumor on two roads stops at my bar to warm up. Most of them leave taller than they came in.
